description:
Cast Rejoinder using Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Elite Interceptor.
When Elite Interceptor enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

uses.name: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia
